record.label: T counts for uncontrolled and controlled walk steps
record.statement: Appendix H.4 reports 30,116 T gates per uncontrolled walk step and 30,132 per controlled boundary step. It also counts 76 T gates per step for QSP rotations and 245 T gates of one-time overhead.
record.boundary: The two controlled steps incur a combined allowance of $2\cdot30{,}132$ T gates. The $d=3{,}326{,}847$ uncontrolled steps each carry a 30,116-T allowance for the walk and 76 T gates for the rotation. The total includes a one-time allowance of 245 T gates.
